description: This file contains the configuration for WebSocket messaging in the LMS backend, setting up STOMP endpoints and message broker options.

classes.name: WebSocketConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up WebSocket message broker with STOMP protocol in a Spring application.

methods.name: registerStompEndpoints
methods.description: Registers the WebSocket endpoint at '/ws' with SockJS fallback and allows all origins.

methods.name: configureMessageBroker
methods.description: Configures message broker destinations and prefixes for messaging routing.
